meaning: Complete mixed physical assessment: source availability and useful hazard retention improved, but several obstacle goals remain blocked or contact-bearing. Measurement PASS never means avoidance success. No harmless-contact or physical-robot safety threshold is claimed.
improvement_qualification: Observed improvement is narrower than universal goal completion: all22 final reactive runs had zero source-unavailability stops at unchanged1s budget; RGB-D partial/separated/empty default cases reach strict-clear goals; static/thin/large remain blocked. Narrow times out with contact-offset proximity reports only, zero penetration/impulse and positive6.271mm cooked clearance. Source/coverage baseline records retain their failures separately.

findings: Ground-truth reactive retains nine strict-clear goals out of ten; the large wall remains a noncontact local-planner timeout.

RGB-D default2Hz partial, separated and empty reach strict-clear goals. Static, sparse and large time out without reported contact; narrow times out with257 contact-offset proximity points but zero penetration/impulse and positive6.271mm cooked clearance, not demonstrated impact. Freshness alone does not solve local planner/partial geometry limitations.

RGB-D moving reaches the goal with lower maximum depth/normal impulse than direct but many more reported points and much longer motion. This is mixed severity/completion evidence, not collision-free success or harmless contact.
Four additional reactive2.5Hz cases are separate experiments, not substitutes chosen to hide default2Hz outcomes. Every attempted final result is retained.
Bounded surface completion was rejected after both sparse/static native trials timed out. Added UNKNOWN geometry was not adopted. Sampling phase cycling remains an unadopted offline probe.

severity_policy.contact_offset_meaning: Positive separation with zero impulse is proximity rather than demonstrated solid penetration; strict V2 still fails any reported point.
severity_policy.raw_contact_meaning: Negative separation/normal impulse is measured physical contact, ungraded for acceptability. Depth, impulse, force, duration and motion speed remain separate.
severity_policy.force_meaning: Normal pair impulse divided by verified physics dt is a step-average normal force, excluding friction and substep peaks.
severity_policy.speed_meaning: SDK COM-correct instantaneous post-solver velocity and frame-displacement contact-point velocity are both reported; neither is assumed pre-impact approach speed.

limitations: No physical-robot safety validation, pushing, automatic contact detector, carried-object or intended-contact reactive skill is introduced.
One final run per source/scenario/strategy/cadence; no statistical reliability or global completeness claim.
Sampled cooked-hull clearance excludes contact/rest offsets and cannot certify continuous/substep clearance.
Snapshots and exact cuboids represent partial observations; unobserved interiors and omitted occupied evidence remain observable limitations.
Software/regression PASS is recorded separately in verification.json and does not alter these physical outcomes.
